_note: Nat_multitask_convnext_base (multi-task CNN, trainer train/train_multi_task_cnn.py): ConvNeXt-Base pretrained on ImageNet-22k and fine-tuned on ImageNet-1k (convnext_base.fb_in22k_ft_in1k via timm) with two linear heads (crop 55, disease 175) and CE + label smoothing 0.1 summed with fixed equal weights.

model._note: backbone: convnext_base.fb_in22k_ft_in1k (ConvNeXt-Base pretrained on ImageNet-22k and fine-tuned on ImageNet-1k via timm).

loss._note: weighting: 'fixed' = sum of weights[h] * CE_h; 'uncertainty' = Kendall et al. 2018, sum of exp(-s_h) * CE_h + s_h with learnable log-variances s_h (init init_log_var; weights ignored). v1: fixed 1.0 / 1.0 like the baseline.

optimizer._note: name: adamw or sgd (momentum/nesterov only used by sgd). Same LRs and weight decay as aniq_baseline_multitask_cnn.
optimizer.name: adamw

scheduler._note: Per optimizer step. name: cosine (decays to min_lr_ratio x base LR), step (x step_factor every step_size_epochs) or none; linear warmup over warmup_epochs first. v1: cosine, no warmup, as the baseline.
scheduler.name: cosine

training._note: freeze_backbone_epochs: heads-only warm-up epochs (BN frozen). accum_steps: effective batch = batch_size x accum_steps. grad_clip_norm: 0 = off. early_stopping.patience: stop a split after this many epochs without a better best-gamma val HM (0 = off, never before min_epochs). refit_schedule: 'compress' (schedule over the selected epoch count, as train_cnn.py) or 'match_stage1' (schedule over max_epochs, stop at the selected epoch).

runtime._note: Local RTX 4050 settings. On Colab override with --set runtime.num_workers=2. checkpoint_every_n_epochs: save runs/.../checkpoints/last.pt every N epochs and at the end of each split/refit (0 = off), used by --resume; 5 limits Drive writes while losing at most 4 epochs on a disconnect. keep_checkpoints=false deletes it after a successful run.
